explication: Geode is a Geometry Dash mod loader and modding SDK. A mod developer builds against Geode’s bindings and modification APIs; when Geometry Dash starts, the loader discovers and manages mods, installs hooks, dispatches lifecycle/game events, and exposes Cocos2d-based UI and state services. Downloads and settings support the broader mod lifecycle. The graph reflects the README and sampled headers/source; several loader subsystems are represented by exact tree paths without claiming unsampled call details.
